commands.name: player.play
commands.label: Play
commands.description: Start or resume playback of the current queue entry.

commands.name: player.pause
commands.label: Pause
commands.description: Pause playback.

commands.name: player.toggle
commands.label: Play or pause
commands.description: Play when paused, pause when playing.

commands.name: player.next
commands.label: Next track
commands.description: Move to the next queue entry, following shuffle and repeat.

commands.name: player.previous
commands.label: Previous track
commands.description: Move to the previous queue entry.

commands.name: player.seek
commands.label: Seek
commands.description: Seek to a position in the playing track, in seconds or as a percentage of its length. Give one of the two.

commands.name: player.seek_relative
commands.label: Seek by
commands.description: Seek forward (positive) or back (negative) by a number of seconds.

seconds.description: Seconds to move; negative moves back

commands.name: player.volume
commands.label: Volume
commands.description: Set the volume (0 to 1) or change it by a step (-1 to 1). Give one of the two.

commands.name: player.mute
commands.label: Mute
commands.description: Mute or unmute. Without `muted` it toggles.

commands.name: player.status
commands.label: Player status
commands.description: What is playing: track id, title, artist, album, position and duration in seconds, playing or paused, volume, muted, shuffle, repeat, and the decoder route.

commands.name: player.snapshot
commands.label: Runtime snapshot
commands.description: The whole runtime state in one record, shaped after cliamp's IPC v2 snapshot: state, track (id and display fields, no path), position, duration, volume in dB, mute, speed, mono, shuffle, repeat, queue length, index and revision, the name of the saved playlist the queue was loaded from, EQ preset, visualiser mode, the DSP route, and a revision that moves when any of these change.

commands.name: queue.read
commands.label: Read queue
commands.description: A page of the play queue: each entry's position, track id, title, artist, album and duration, plus the current position, shuffle and repeat.

commands.name: queue.set
commands.label: Replace queue
commands.description: Replace the queue with these tracks and start at `startIndex` (default 0). Undo restores the previous queue.

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.add
commands.label: Add to queue
commands.description: Add tracks to the end of the queue.

ids.description: Track ids. Omitted: the selected tracks, or the playing track

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.play_next
commands.label: Play next
commands.description: Insert tracks right after the playing entry.

ids.description: Track ids. Omitted: the selected tracks, or the playing track

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.move
commands.label: Move in queue
commands.description: Move the entry at position `from` to position `to` (0-based).

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.remove
commands.label: Remove from queue
commands.description: Remove entries by position (0-based). Omitted: the selected queue entries.

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.clear
commands.label: Clear queue
commands.description: Empty the queue. Undo brings it back.

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.shuffle
commands.label: Shuffle
commands.description: Set shuffle to off, tracks or albums (albums keeps track order inside each album). Without `mode` it moves to the next mode.

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.repeat
commands.label: Repeat
commands.description: Set repeat to off, all or one. Without `mode` it moves to the next mode.

commands.name: queue.play
commands.label: Play queue entry
commands.description: Jump to a queue entry and play it: by position (`index`, 0-based, from queue.read) or by track id (`id`, the first entry holding that track). Give one of the two. The queue itself is unchanged.

id.description: Track id of a queued entry

if_revision.description: The queue revision this edit expects (player.snapshot queue.revision, or queue.read revision). A stale one is refused with [conflict].

commands.name: queue.undo
commands.label: Undo queue edit
commands.description: Undo the last queue or playlist edit.

commands.name: queue.save_playlist
commands.label: Save queue as playlist
commands.description: Save the queue as an M3U8 playlist file in the music folder. Refuses when a playlist with that name exists.

commands.name: library.search
commands.label: Search library
commands.description: Fuzzy search over title, artist, album, album artist, file name and genre. Returns a page of tracks (id, title, artist, album, year, duration) and the total.

commands.name: library.browse
commands.label: Browse library
commands.description: List groups (albums, artists, genres, years, folders) or, with `key`, the tracks in one group; or the recently added, recently played, most played, favourite and rated lists. Pages by 20.

key.description: Group key from a previous browse

commands.name: track.read
commands.label: Read track
commands.description: One track's tags and state: title, artist, album, album artist, track and disc, year, genre, duration, codec, rating, favourite, play count, last played, ReplayGain values.

commands.name: track.rate
commands.label: Rate
commands.description: Rate tracks from 0 (no rating) to 5 stars. Stored in the index, not the file.

ids.description: Track ids. Omitted: the selected tracks, or the playing track

commands.name: track.favourite
commands.label: Favourite
commands.description: Mark or unmark tracks as favourites. Without `favourite` it toggles.

ids.description: Track ids. Omitted: the selected tracks, or the playing track

commands.name: track.edit_tags
commands.label: Edit tags
commands.description: Write tags into the audio files (Chromium only). Shows the change and waits for approval; keeps a backup until the rewritten file reads back the same.

coverFrom.description: A MusicBrainz release id: its Cover Art Archive front cover is written as the cover art (needs the Cover Art Archive turned on)

commands.name: playlist.list
commands.label: List playlists
commands.description: The playlists in the music folder (M3U, M3U8, PLS, XSPF, JSPF and smart playlists): name, kind and track count. With `name`, that playlist's entries instead: position, track id (null when the file is not in the library), title and artist.

commands.name: playlist.create
commands.label: New playlist
commands.description: Create an M3U8 playlist in the music folder, optionally with tracks.

commands.name: playlist.add
commands.label: Add to playlist
commands.description: Append tracks to a playlist. Omitted ids: the selected tracks, or the playing track.

ids.description: Track ids. Omitted: the selected tracks, or the playing track

commands.name: playlist.delete
commands.label: Delete playlist
commands.description: Delete a playlist file from the music folder. Shows what goes and waits for approval.

commands.name: playlist.rename
commands.label: Rename playlist
commands.description: Rename an M3U or M3U8 playlist: writes it under the new file name in the same folder and removes the old file. Refuses when the new name is taken. Undo (queue.undo) puts the old file back.

commands.name: playlist.remove
commands.label: Remove from playlist
commands.description: Remove one entry from an M3U or M3U8 playlist by position (from playlist.list with `name`). Rewrites only the playlist file; the audio file is never touched. Shows the entry and waits for approval.

commands.name: smart.create
commands.label: New smart playlist
commands.description: Save a smart playlist rule as <name>.nakliamp-smart.json in the music folder. Rules match all or any; each is { field, op, value }.

match.description: Match all rules or any rule

value.description: Value: text, number, or [low, high] for between

commands.name: smart.list
commands.label: List smart playlists
commands.description: The smart playlists in the music folder, with their rules and current track counts.

commands.name: eq.preset
commands.label: EQ preset
commands.description: Pick an equaliser preset, or set the custom curve (10 bands, -12 to 12 dB).

custom.description: Custom gains in dB, 70 Hz to 16 kHz

commands.name: eq.enable
commands.label: Equaliser on or off
commands.description: Turn the equaliser on or off. Without `enabled` it toggles.

commands.name: sound.replaygain
commands.label: ReplayGain
commands.description: Set ReplayGain: off, track, album or auto (album gain inside an album run, track gain otherwise), the preamp in dB, and clipping prevention.

preventClipping.description: Lower the gain when the peak would clip

commands.name: sound.crossfade
commands.label: Crossfade
commands.description: Crossfade length in seconds, 0 (off) to 12. Never applied between tracks of one album when gapless applies.

commands.name: sound.gapless
commands.label: Gapless
commands.description: Gapless playback: off, albums (within one album) or always.

commands.name: visualiser.mode
commands.label: Visualiser
commands.description: Pick a visualiser mode by id, or move through the modes by `step`.

commands.name: visualiser.full
commands.label: Full-window visualiser
commands.description: Show the visualiser over the whole window, or leave it. Without `on` it toggles.

commands.name: visualiser.picker
commands.label: Visualiser picker
commands.description: Open the visualiser picker, where every mode draws live in a small tile, or close it. Without `open` it toggles.

commands.name: spectrum.get
commands.label: Spectrum
commands.description: The current spectrum as `bands` log-spaced levels from 0 to 1 (default 32, 20 Hz to 20 kHz), read from the same analyser the visualiser draws. Empty when nothing plays. One frame per call, as cliamp's spectrum.get.

commands.name: visualiser.link_volume
commands.label: Link visualiser to volume
commands.description: Scale the visualiser's input by the current volume, so a quiet player draws a quiet picture. Without `on` it toggles. Milkdrop reads the audio graph itself and is not scaled.

commands.name: view.open
commands.label: Open view
commands.description: Open a view: the library, a browse view, the queue, playlists, search, lyrics, the track inspector, the equaliser, settings or the AI playlist dialog.

commands.name: view.close
commands.label: Close
commands.description: Leave the full-window visualiser, or close the open overlay or dialog.

commands.name: view.keymap
commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
commands.description: Show the keyboard map.

commands.name: ui.theme
commands.label: Theme
commands.description: Light, dark, or system (inside NakliOS: the host theme).

commands.name: ui.mini
commands.label: Mini player
commands.description: Switch to the compact mini player or back. Without `on` it toggles.

commands.name: ui.pop_out
commands.label: Pop out the mini player
commands.description: Move the mini player into a small always-on-top window (Document Picture-in-Picture, Chromium only) or bring it back. Without `on` it toggles. Opening needs a click in the page, so an agent call that is not part of one refuses with [unavailable].

on.description: true pops out, false brings it back

commands.name: ai.playlist
commands.label: Playlist from a description
commands.description: Make a playlist from a description using only tracks in the library. Returns track ids and a title as a preview; nothing is saved until playlist.create. Without a host model it filters by tags and search.

commands.name: player.speed
commands.label: Playback speed
commands.description: Set the playback speed from 0.5 to 2, or step it up or down. Pitch is kept where the route supports it.

commands.name: player.stop_after_current
commands.label: Stop after this track
commands.description: Stop when the playing track ends. Without `on` it toggles.

on.description: true arms it, false disarms it

commands.name: player.sleep_timer
commands.label: Sleep timer
commands.description: Pause after a number of minutes (the last 10 seconds fade out), at the end of this track, or at the end of the queue. Mode off cancels it.

mode.description: When to stop instead of minutes

commands.name: player.volume_db
commands.label: Volume in dB
commands.description: Set the volume in dB (0 is full, the floor setting is the quietest audible step), or change it by a number of dB. Give one of the two.

commands.name: sound.mono
commands.label: Mono
commands.description: Mix left and right into one channel on both speakers. Without `on` it toggles.

commands.name: sound.volume_floor
commands.label: Volume floor
commands.description: The quietest audible step of the volume slider, from -90 to -1 dB (default -50).

commands.name: sound.devices
commands.label: Output devices
commands.description: The audio outputs this browser offers (id and label) and the one in use. Empty where the browser cannot pick an output.

commands.name: sound.output
commands.label: Output device
commands.description: Play through another audio output by its id from sound.devices; an empty id is the system default.

commands.name: eq.import_eqf
commands.label: Import EQF preset
commands.description: Load an .eqf equaliser preset file chosen by the person into the custom equaliser curve. `presetIndex` picks one preset from a library file (default 0).

commands.name: eq.export_eqf
commands.label: Export EQF preset
commands.description: Save the current equaliser curve as an .eqf preset file.

commands.name: history.clear
commands.label: Clear listening history
commands.description: Reset every track's play count and last-played time, which empties the recently played and most played lists. Ratings and favourites stay. Shows how many tracks change and waits for approval; it cannot be undone.

commands.name: library.duplicates
commands.label: Duplicates
commands.description: Groups of tracks that look like the same recording: exact (same size and length) or likely (same artist and title within 2 seconds), with the suggested keeper. Nothing is deleted.

commands.name: library.folders
commands.label: Music folders
commands.description: The music folders in the library: id, name, whether it is the primary folder, and whether the read grant is live.

commands.name: library.add_folder
commands.label: Add a music folder
commands.description: Ask the person for another music folder and index it. Removing it again is library.forget_folder.

commands.name: library.forget_folder
commands.label: Remove a music folder
commands.description: Remove a folder and its tracks and playlists from the library index. The files on disk are untouched.

commands.name: library.rescan_folder
commands.label: Rescan
commands.description: Rescan one folder by id, or every folder when `id` is absent.

commands.name: tags.rename_files
commands.label: Rename files from tags
commands.description: Rename audio files from a pattern of tags, such as "%track% - %title%". Shows every old and new name and waits for approval. Chromium only.

commands.name: tags.find_replace
commands.label: Find and replace in tags
commands.description: Replace text in title, artist, album, album artist or genre tags. Shows every change and waits for approval.

commands.name: tags.lookup_musicbrainz
commands.label: Look up on MusicBrainz
commands.description: Search MusicBrainz for the album of these tracks (or the album and artist given) and return releases and per-track tag changes as a preview. Needs MusicBrainz turned on.

ids.description: Track ids. Omitted: the selected tracks, or the playing track

mbid.description: A release id to fetch tag changes for

commands.name: tags.fetch_cover
commands.label: Preview a cover
commands.description: Fetch a release's front cover from the Cover Art Archive as a preview. Writing it goes through track.edit_tags with coverFrom.

commands.name: lyrics.fetch
commands.label: Find lyrics online
commands.description: Look up lyrics on LRCLIB for a track (default: the playing track) and show them. Nothing is saved. Needs LRCLIB turned on.

commands.name: lyrics.save_sidecar
commands.label: Save lyrics beside the track
commands.description: Fetch lyrics from LRCLIB and write them as a .lrc file beside the track. Undo removes the new file.

commands.name: queue.more_like_this
commands.label: More like this
commands.description: Add tracks like the playing one to the end of the queue: by shared tags, reranked by the host model when there is one.

commands.name: ai.suggest_genres
commands.label: Suggest missing genres
commands.description: Ask the host model for a genre for each album that has none. Returns suggestions only; each approved album is written with track.edit_tags.

commands.name: ui.command_bar
commands.label: Command bar
commands.description: Open the command bar: type a request in words and it runs one command. Destructive commands are never run from it.

commands.name: view.skins
commands.label: Classic skin face
commands.description: Open the classic skin face: pick a .wsz skin file from disk and control playback through it. The sound still comes from NakliAmp.

commands.name: network.list
commands.label: Network services
commands.description: The online services NakliAmp can use, what each one receives, and whether the person turned it on. All are off by default.

commands.name: network.grant
commands.label: Turn a service on
commands.description: Allow NakliAmp to contact one service. Nothing is sent to it until this is on. NakliAmp shows what the service receives and asks the person every time, whoever calls.

commands.name: network.revoke
commands.label: Turn a service off
commands.description: Stop NakliAmp contacting one service.

commands.name: scrobble.status
commands.label: Scrobbling status
commands.description: ListenBrainz scrobbling: whether it is on, whether a token is set (never the token), listens waiting, listens refused, and the next send time.

commands.name: scrobble.flush
commands.label: Send listens now
commands.description: Send waiting listens to ListenBrainz now.

errorCodes.meaning: No command, track, playlist or handler by that name.
The input does not match the command's JSON Schema.
The person did not approve a destructive command.
The queue changed since the `if_revision` the command carried.
The command cannot run here (no music folder, no tag writing in this browser, no host model).
